arguments.query: WITH o AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND c.tier='G' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2024-12-31 16:00:00' AND o.order_ts<'2025-12-31 16:00:00') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items oi JOIN o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id)/100.0 AS gross, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r JOIN o ON o.order_id=r.order_id) AS refunds
